strings.pageDescription: Use this Full EAP form to define the Trigger Model for your Early Action Protocol.
strings.cancelConfirmMessage: Discard unsaved changes and restore the last saved draft?
strings.draftSaveErrorMessage: The draft could not be saved in this browser. Your form is still open.
strings.draftSaveSuccessMessage: The draft was saved in this browser.
strings.savedDraftInvalidMessage: The saved browser draft could not be read and was reset. A blank form is ready.
strings.storageUnavailableMessage: Browser storage is unavailable. You can continue editing, but Save and close cannot store this draft.
strings.shareWebSuccessMessage: The draft was shared as a JSON file.
strings.shareClipboardSuccessMessage: The draft JSON was copied to the clipboard.
strings.shareDownloadSuccessMessage: The draft was downloaded as a JSON file.
strings.shareErrorMessage: The draft could not be shared in this browser.
strings.pilotSelectionDescription: Select an existing pilot to load its activation triggers, or leave this blank and complete the form manually.
strings.pilotLoadingDescription: The Trigger Builder reference data is being loaded.
strings.pilotLoadErrorTitle: Pilot EAPs could not be loaded
strings.pilotLoadErrorDescription: You can still complete the blank form manually, or retry loading the Trigger Builder reference data.
strings.pilotEmptyDescription: Complete the blank trigger form manually.
strings.countrySelectionDescription: The country limits geography search and supplies the national selection. Pilot EAPs select a matching country when one can be identified.
strings.requiredFieldError: This field is required before generating.
strings.triggerLogicDescription: Define the threshold, timing, and probability for this activation trigger.
strings.generationNotesPlaceholder: Add one required fact per line, for example: Lake Chilwa Basin: 150 mm
strings.geographyDescription: Enter the complete target geography from the EAP. Confirm the text directly, or use map/search for one location or an optional reference pin.
strings.geographyPlaceholder: Enter one place or all document-defined target areas
strings.geographyConfirmedDescription: This structured geography is ready for statement generation.
strings.geographyDocumentConfirmedDescription: The complete text defines the target area. Any map pin is an optional reference point, not the area boundary.
strings.geographyUnverifiedDescription: Confirm the document text, or select and confirm a map location before generation.
strings.geographySelectorLoadingDescription: The map interaction is loading only for this trigger.
strings.forecastSourcesDescription: Add each forecast source and its website link when available.
strings.connectorDescription: Choose how this trigger is connected to the next trigger.
strings.importedConnectorWarningDescription: Some pilot connector logic is unsupported or ambiguous. Choose one of the supported connectors between each trigger.
strings.triggerStatementDescription: Generate the statement with AI from the structured trigger fields, then edit the wording if needed.
strings.triggerStatementPlaceholder: Generate the Trigger statement to begin editing.
strings.generationValidationErrorMessage: Complete the highlighted fields before generating the Trigger statement.
strings.generationRetryMessage: The Trigger statement could not be generated. Please try again.
